svg.title: Reactive versus anticipatory commit (concept)
svg.desc: Concept figure, not data: a stick tip falls onto the impact surface. The reactive arm commits after the crossing has been observed; the anticipatory arms commit earlier from the motion so far; both then pay the audio latency.
svg.text: CONCEPT · WHEN DOES THE COMMIT HAPPEN?

g.text: audio scheduling and output latency still apply

svg.text: L_eff ≈ max(0, L_sys − L_pred) is a conceptual relation only. Effective latency is claimed nowhere until the live measurement (Phase 18) exists.
